snippet.title: Fate and Destiny - The Elonia Chronicles Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
Fate And Destiny plunges you into a heroic fantasy universe inspired by “dungeon crawler” boardgame.
Experience an epic adventure during a 15-chapters campaign, where you'll meet a host of characters and explore a variety of locations.
Play as different warriors with different characteristics, equip yourself with items to improve your stats, battle ferocious enemies and try to survive the many dangers that await you!

Game available in: English, French, German and Spanish.

Available soon on Steam.
Don't hesitate to add the game to your Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669960/Fate_And_Destiny__The_Elonia_Chronicles/
